# What's new

<!-- Generated by crates/book-whats-new from books/gonk/changes.toml: edit that file, not this page.
     ./scripts/test-books.sh writes it, and a test fails when the two disagree. -->

What has changed in The gonk Book, most recent first: the date, what was added or changed, and the pages to read for it. Smaller upkeep (moving to a newer release when nothing a reader does changes, a corrected link, a typo) is not listed.

## 2026-10

- **2026-10-21**: A new chapter, Routing work to agents, runs the gonk starter's unattended worker loop: a router dispatches an item with `gonk.py dispatch` (with `--as` over the socket), a worker takes only what a router in its required `routers` list dispatched, the item's comments reach the agent as quoted data under their authors, and one worker machine runs one loop per agent (`worker.py init-agents`, the `gonk-worker@<agent>` units, `worker_repos.py`). Remote workers now says a label routes nothing by itself. Every page was replayed against the newer gonk the book now pins (its revision is in the introduction), ikigai-cli 0.1.67 and the starter's main: the HTTP door no longer lets an anonymous caller write, so the ledger pages file over the socket and the kata and roborev bridges show gonk refusing them; a spent anonymous budget answers 429 with Retry-After; access-log lines carry the defaults core fills in and the new outcome kinds; MCP error results add a `kind: …; class: …` line and `ikigai mcp` answers calls concurrently; a query naming a graph outside its dataset is refused by name; and each With the starter section shows the starter's new files, AGENTS.md section and init rows.

The introduction also says how to install the `model-stub` the later chapters start, and that Over MCP is the first page to need the `quic` feature; a few cross-references now point at the right chapter.

  Pages: [Introduction](introduction.md), [The ledger in a browser](ledger/browser.md)
